  PROBLEM SOLVING USING COMPUTERS [CSE 1071-CHM]

  A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1A)          Compare and contrast between machine language, assembly language, and high-level  
  language in terms of their syntax and level of abstraction.                             (3)  
  
  1B)          Write the output of the given expression using precedence and associativity rules:  
  
  
  (3)  
  
  
  1C)          Write an algorithm and draw a flowchart to check whether a given integer is palindrome  
  or not.                                                                                (4)  
  
  2A)          Write a c program to check whether entered year is a leap year or not. Also read number  
  of days and convert those number of days to years and weeks.                            (3)  
  
  2B)          i) Write a C program to display Prime Numbers between two Intervals entered by the      (5)

  (3+2 = 5 marks)  
  
  2C)   Write a C program to find the sum of squares of natural numbers up to n.  
  (2)  
  
  3A)   Write a C program that reads N number of lines and creates a 2D character array of  
  pyramid as follows. Each row in the 2D array should represent a line. Do not hard code  
  the output. Assume N < = 5. Ask the user a row number to display and then display the  
  particular row of pyramid.  
  
  (3)  
  
  
  3B)   List and explain the different ways of initializing a 2D array of integer.  
  (3)  
  
  3C)   Write a C program to read an integer matrix of size M x N. create a 1D array of size  
  M+N and store the maximum element of each row of the matrix in the first M positions  
  of the 1D array. Store the minimum value of each column of the matrix in the next N  
  elements of the 1D array. Find the mean value and variance of the 1D array and display (4)  
  them.  
  Variance = average of sum of square of difference between the element and the mean  
  value of the array.  
  
  4A)   Write a C program using a function to check whether a number can be expressed as a  
  sum of two prime numbers. To perform this task, a user-defined function is created to  
  check prime number. If that number can be expressed as sum of two prime numbers,               (3)  
  then, print that "number is expressed as sum of two prime numbers" else print "it can't  
  be expressed as sum of two prime numbers".  
  
  4B)   Explain recursion and the steps to design a recursive algorithm with suitable example.  
  Write a C program to find the sum of n digits using recursion and explain the role of  
  static variable in this program?                                                               (5)  
  (2+3 = 5 marks)  
  
  4C)   Write a program that takes a number from the user and pass the number to a function  
  that tests whether the number is a perfect square or not. If it is a perfect square, it returns  
  1, otherwise it returns 0 to the main program which then displays the appropriate               (2)  
  message.  
  
  5A)   Write a C program to check if the string is palindrome or not using pointers.  
  (3)  
  
  5B)   Differentiate between Surface Web, Deep Web, and Dark Web.  
  (3)  
  
  5C)   Write a C program using structures to read the name and total marks of individual  
  student for a class of N students. Compute average marks of the class and display names (4)  
  of the students scoring above and below the average marks.
